_meta.note: Pluggable external evidence corpus. Records are matched to claims by (company_id, metric_key, year). Curated via scripts/build_evidence_corpus.py (template -> validate -> merge; trusted tiers must cite document + page/table). 2026-07-03: illustrative placeholders replaced with real page-cited figures read from the on-disk filings via Docling (Shell SR 2023 p.79/81, Tata Power BRSR 2023-24 p.30).

quality_values.verified: Sourced from a verified third-party filing/dataset (CDP, audited report). Counts as production-grade ground truth.
quality_values.self_reported: From the company's own filings (page-cited). Stored records of this tier check cross-document consistency; cross-report evidence found at runtime is also tagged this tier.
quality_values.illustrative: Placeholder value for demos — NOT a real figure. Must not be presented as verified.
quality_values.unverified: Default when a record omits quality.

record_schema.quality: string (verified | illustrative | unverified) — machine-readable trust tier
